a trust vector approach is proposed to depict the trust of a service provider with more indications and a fuzzy regression based trust prediction method is presented to predict the trustworthness of a forthcoming transaction.

we propose a novel fuzzy regression model based trust prediction approach to evaluate the trust of a service provider or a seller, which can be used to make better decisions for buyers or service customers in the e-commerce and e-service applications.
